parts.text: New: pay with GCash, dark mode, delivery ETA, open-now filter, Filipino language, one-tap reorder. Improved: faster restaurant list, live rider location, grouped notifications, accessibility on checkout. Fixed: expired order crash, coupon total, Android 15 login loop, double charge, map pin, peso sign on receipts, and a security fix. Heads up: the app now needs Android 7.0 or later.
